title: Red Hat Security Advisory: subscription-manager-cockpit security update
description: Red Hat has issued a security update for subscription-manager-cockpit addressing two vulnerabilities in the lodash library: CVE-2026-4800, which allows arbitrary code execution via untrusted input in template imports, and CVE-2026-2950, which permits prototype pollution enabling deletion of built-in prototype properties via an array path bypass. These vulnerabilities affect Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9 across multiple architectures. The update is rated as Important by Red Hat Product Security.
